content:
maria-oncall: Pager triggered: gen-queue alerts for us-west, elevated 5xx rate ~3.2% starting 10:21 UTC. Auto-escalation to oncall.
incident-bot: Pager created — incident id INC-2026-233, severity P1. Pager routed to maria-oncall and sam-sre.
maria-oncall: I'm on it. Initial triage: autoscaler failures causing driver restarts and KV cache pressure. Impact: generation endpoints returning 5xx, some increased latency.
ben-eng: Thx. Can you share a short customer-facing impact sentence? I'll draft the status update.
emily-ops: Heads-up: legal needs to review any wording that mentions SLA or data loss. @legal-bot please standby.
sam-sre: Observability notes: error spike at 10:18, KV cache growth, OOMs on a subset of nodes. Rolling fallback routing and node restarts in progress.
maria-oncall: Draft for initial status page below — quick review please.
ben-eng: (paste draft) ```Initial notice: We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and increased latency affecting generation endpoints in us-west. Some requests may fail or experience delays. Our engineers are actively investigating and working on mitigations. We will post updates every 15 minutes.```
emily-ops: Suggest small edits: add 'affected customers' line and avoid saying "UI". Try: 'Affected customers: API users in us-west may experience failed generation requests or elevated latency.'
maria-oncall: Updated draft below — ready to publish once legal ok and oncall confirms mitigation plan. ```We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and increased latency affecting generation endpoints in us-west. Some API requests may fail or experience delays. Mitigation: routing fallback enabled to secondary pools; rolling restart of autoscaler in progress. Next update: ~15 minutes.```
legal-bot: Quick check: wording ok; avoid SLA promises. Recommend keeping ETA tentative.
emily-ops: I'll change to 'Next update: ~15 minutes.' Done.
ben-eng: Ready to publish initial update. @maria-oncall please publish to status page and send a customer-facing note to the affected accounts list.
maria-oncall: Publishing now.
incident-bot: Statuspage update posted (INC-2026-233-1). Public notice URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-233
maria-oncall: Sent customer email to affected accounts with short summary + link.
sam-sre: Autoscaler restart started at 10:28; partial restart completed on subset of nodes. Error rate dropping to 0.6%.
ben-eng: Drafting 15-min update: ```Update: Autoscaler restart completed for a subset of nodes; error rates decreasing. Routing fallback remains enabled. Engineers continuing validation.```
emily-ops: LGTM. @maria-oncall queue the 15-min update.
maria-oncall: Posted 15-min update.
incident-bot: Posted update INC-2026-233-2
ben-eng: Recommend resolved once sustained <0.5% for 30 minutes.
maria-oncall: Monitoring window started at 10:40.
sam-sre: At 11:12 error rate steady ~0.1%, KV cache stable. Ready for resolved notice.
emily-ops: Send resolved notice and include short remediation summary + postmortem placeholder. Ben can write remediation bullets.
ben-eng: Resolved draft: ```Resolved: The generation errors in US West have been resolved. Root cause: an autoscaler regression that caused rapid driver restarts and KV cache OOM on a subset of nodes. Mitigation: rolled back autoscaler, restarted affected nodes, and enabled routing fallback. Next steps: postmortem and long-term autoscaler fix.```
maria-oncall: Publishing resolved now.
incident-bot: Statuspage update posted (INC-2026-233-resolved). Public notice: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-233/resolved
emily-ops: Thanks all. I'll open the postmortem doc, assign follow-ups, and link when ready. :thumbsup:
